Don't use type.title. → Vivid</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the accessibility tokens: <a href="foundations/accessibility">Accessibility →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="naming"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="naming-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Naming</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 1 decision, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="naming-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-roles"><div class="odv-q">What gets a name?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Tokens and component keys</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Components get their own keys.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Every campaign</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-count"><div class="odv-q">How many token tiers?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Three</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Primitives, semantics and component keys.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Every campaign</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-definition"><div class="odv-q">How are decisions named?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">By role</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Role names survive each campaign.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Every campaign</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-values"><div class="odv-q">How are names written?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Lowercase words in paths</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Lowercase paths read the same everywhere.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → An agency</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the naming tokens: <a href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="naming-lands"><div class="odv-q">What do components read?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Component keys</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Campaigns change primitives, never components.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Every campaign</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a value with no token, use the closest semantic token, then ask for a new one. Don't use a raw value in the component. The next campaign changes primitives; raw values would stay behind.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/naming">Naming →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" id="voice"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="voice-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Voice and tone</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 14 decisions, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="voice-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which kinds of copy does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Labels, messages and headlines</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Headlines carry the campaign.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What does the product do for the business? → Sells and converts</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the voice and tone tokens: <a href="foundations/voice">Voice and tone →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-count"><div class="odv-q">How many tones does it use?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">One per moment</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Playful in headlines, plain in errors.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is a costly mistake? → Looking off-brand</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (7)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (2)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For the words of an error, use plain first, a light touch after. Don't use a joke before the fix. Playful copy must never hide what went wrong.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a confirmation question, use Plain. No jokes when something is lost. Don't use playful copy. Loss is never the moment for a joke.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" → Bold</li><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Loud</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (6)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (5)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a paragraph or help text, use type.body, short. Don't use long paragraphs. Short copy keeps the energy.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/typography">Typography →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a button label, use a short verb that moves: Join, Try, Go. Don't use &quot;Learn more&quot;. Big moments need verbs with energy.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a success message, use celebrate, briefly. Don't use a long thank-you. A short celebration is remembered.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For an empty state, use playful, with a clear next step. Don't use a dead end. Playful words still need a way forward.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a first visit, use one bold line and one button. Don't use a paragraph of copy. Visitors from a social post give a few seconds.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" See you at launch.</span><a class="odv-go" href="components/toast">Toast →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="voice-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where do the words matter most?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Headlines and buttons</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Words work hardest in headlines and buttons.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Which outcome matters most? → Engagement</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">For a button label, use a short verb that moves: Join, Try, Go. Don't use &quot;Learn more&quot;. Big moments need verbs with energy.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/voice">Voice →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section><section class="odv-qsec" class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">Toggle's default variant isn't used. Sections lead with media and color blocks, not toolbars; a toggle with no border is lost on vivid color.</span><a class="odv-go" href="components/toggle">Toggle →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-count"><div class="odv-q">How far does the inventory reach?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Only what today's screens use</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">One action and a story need only the parts in use; an agency keeps them fresh.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How often do people repeat actions? → Rarely</li><li>Who maintains the system? → An agency</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-definition"><div class="odv-q">How does a component earn its place?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">It gives the brand a moment</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">A component joins when it gives the campaign a moment.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What should the brand feel like? → Bold</li><li>Which outcome matters most? → Engagement</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided (1)</b><div class="odv-dgroup"><div class="odv-dgroup-t"><svg class="odv-kind-icon" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.33" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10.6667 10.6667L12.6667 5.33334L14.6667 10.6667C14.0867 11.1 13.3867 11.3333 12.6667 11.3333C11.9467 11.3333 11.2467 11.1 10.6667 10.6667Z"/><path d="M1.33331 10.6667L3.33331 5.33334L5.33331 10.6667C4.75331 11.1 4.05331 11.3333 3.33331 11.3333C2.61331 11.3333 1.91331 11.1 1.33331 10.6667Z"/><path d="M4.66669 14H11.3334"/><path d="M8 2V14"/><path d="M2 4.66668H3.33333C4.66667 4.66668 6.66667 4.00001 8 3.33334C9.33333 4.00001 11.3333 4.66668 12.6667 4.66668H14"/></svg>Rules it sets (1)</div><ul class="odv-tree"><li><span class="odv-dec-what">When no component in the inventory fits, use a section built from the inventory with campaign tokens. Don't use a new component for one campaign. Campaigns change the look through tokens; new parts every drop are hard to keep working.</span><a class="odv-go" href="foundations/components">Components →</a></li></ul></div></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-values"><div class="odv-q">When does a component get another look?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Also for emphasis and size</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Variants for emphasis and size let each campaign look a little different.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>How fast does it change? → Every campaign</li><li>How visible is the brand in the interface? → Loud</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-lands"><div class="odv-q">Where do components do the most work?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Campaign sections</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Components sit inside big campaign sections.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Images and campaigns</li><li>What is the main task? → Browse and explore</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div></div></section></div>
